# Open Brand Definition

Project: Open Brand Definition
Specification: OBDS
Current release: 1.0.1 (stable, 27 August 2026)
Publisher: Kill The Dragon GmbH, Vienna, Austria
Canonical address: https://openbranddefinition.org/

## Purpose

A governed brand control layer for AI systems.

OBDS determines which brand truth applies in a declared context, compiles the
exact context for one task, declares the permissible design space a renderer
may create inside, and records why a result was released, blocked or routed to
approval.

It is not a brandbook format, a prompt library or a template system.

## Minimum

OBDS Foundation. Nothing above it is required.

Foundation covers Brand Elements, the four Brand States, Rules, Scope,
Semantic Boundaries, provenance and Value Contracts.

## Optional capabilities

Added only when the task requires them. Registered Runtime Capability
identifiers in 1.0:

  compiled-runtime
  context-delivery
  context-assembly
  text
  visual-operations
  composition
  claims
  localisation
  operations

Optional Brand Profile identifiers in 1.0:

  obds-governed-records
  obds-release-approval
  obds-claims-evidence
  obds-assets-rights
  obds-localisation
  obds-assurance-lineage
  obds-composition
  obds-visual-operations

Every manifest declares obds-foundation. Section 4.2 of the specification
describes the minimal implementation path.

## Core principles

Facts establish truth.
Rules establish obligations.
Semantic Boundaries establish qualitative guidance, not compliance.
Unknown remains unknown, and is never filled in by inference.
Scope determines what applies. asOf determines when.
OBDS defines the permissible design space. Renderers create inside it.

The four Brand States are: defined, unknown, not_defined, not_applicable.
Prohibition is not a state. It is an explicit Rule with obligation: prohibit.

The assembled model input is rendered in this fixed order:
HARD_BOUNDARIES, FACT_GROUNDING, STATE_MAP, GUIDANCE_CONTEXT, TASK_INPUT.

## Licensing

Status: drafted, under review by qualified legal counsel. Not published, and
no licence is granted by the website. The intended model is described at
https://openbranddefinition.org/#licensing and in section 32.1 of the
specification. Independent implementation of the underlying ideas, principles,
methods and formats is not restricted.

## Note

This file is navigation and orientation only. It is not a source of Brand
Truth and it is not normative. The published specification and the published
contracts remain authoritative.
